title: Английские фразовые глаголы
description: Самые употребимые фразовые глаголы с переводом и примером.

cards.question: give up
cards.answer:
сдаваться, бросать
I gave up smoking last year.

cards.question: look after
cards.answer:
присматривать, заботиться
Can you look after my cat?

cards.question: put off
cards.answer:
откладывать
Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.

cards.question: turn down
cards.answer:
отклонять; убавлять (звук)
She turned down the job offer.

cards.question: come across
cards.answer:
случайно наткнуться
I came across an old photo.

cards.question: run out of
cards.answer:
закончиться (о запасах)
We've run out of milk.

cards.question: figure out
cards.answer:
понять, разобраться
I can't figure out how this works.

cards.question: bring up
cards.answer:
воспитывать; поднимать тему
She brought up three kids alone.

cards.question: carry on
cards.answer:
продолжать
Carry on with your work.

cards.question: get along (with)
cards.answer:
ладить
I get along well with my colleagues.

cards.question: break down
cards.answer:
сломаться; расплакаться
The car broke down on the highway.

cards.question: call off
cards.answer:
отменять
The meeting was called off.

cards.question: set up
cards.answer:
основать, настроить
They set up a new company.

cards.question: show up
cards.answer:
появиться, прийти
He showed up an hour late.

cards.question: take off
cards.answer:
взлетать; снимать (одежду)
The plane took off on time.

cards.question: work out
cards.answer:
тренироваться; решить, получиться
Everything worked out in the end.

cards.question: look forward to
cards.answer:
ждать с нетерпением
I'm looking forward to your visit.

cards.question: point out
cards.answer:
указать, отметить
He pointed out a mistake.

cards.question: hold on
cards.answer:
подождать
Hold on a second, please.

cards.question: catch up (with)
cards.answer:
догнать, наверстать
I need to catch up with my studies.
